name: PLATO Large Network-LP Benchmark
description: Benchmarks LP solvers on network-structured linear programming problems, covering 25 instances: 10 standard network problems and 15 large Grid-on-Torus (GOTO) problems with up to 131,072 nodes and 16.7 million arcs. The benchmark tests how well solvers exploit network structure and handle very large sparse problems. Both commercial and free solvers are compared.
typical_sota_score: MOSEK and COPT lead; 3,600-second time limit per instance.
reputation: Niche but authoritative benchmark for network LP; maintained by Hans Mittelmann at ASU.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. GOTO Grid-on-Torus problems are very large (up to 16.7M arcs). Tests both network simplex and interior-point approaches.
